rows.decision_evidence: api/telemetry/wizard.ts:9-45 Vercel function: unauthenticated wizard telemetry ingress; per-IP in-memory rate limit 60/min (:20-25), 10KB payload cap (:28-31), then console.log of the parsed body to Vercel logs (:35-39) and 204. No DB/queue/file writes -> reads-only. Registered via vercel.json functions api/**/*.ts. Review finding: Abuse notes (report only): (1) ANY-method dispatch -- no method check, so GET/HEAD also consume rate budget and log; (2) entire client-supplied body is spread into console.log, so the abuse cost is log injection into Vercel logs within the 10KB/60-per-min bounds; (3) rateLimiter Map keyed by IP is never evicted for IPs that stop sending (per-instance, unbounded key growth) -- minor for serverless lifetimes. keep-and-prove stands.

rows.decision_evidence: Public browser beacon ingress. Guard chain: installRumIngressGuards (app.ts:171 / server.ts:203, metrics-rum-ingress.ts:23-30) -> rumOriginGuard + rumLimiter (120 req/30s/IP, metrics-rum.guard.ts:135-145) + rumSamplingGuard; then metricsRumRouter (app.ts:173) rumPrivacyGuard (PII strip, guard.ts:150-191), 10kb json limit + zod (metrics-rum.ts:112-123). Stores NOTHING durable: observations go only into process-local prom-client histograms (metrics-rum.ts:156-167); RUM v2 path likewise records in-memory counters only (metrics-rum-v2.ts:156-200). No DB/queue/file -> reads-only per rubric. Review finding: Abuse-surface findings (report, not fix): (1) rumOriginGuard enforces RUM_ORIGIN_ALLOWLIST only when NODE_ENV=production AND ENABLE_RUM_V2=1 (metrics-rum.guard.ts:86-94); with v2 off and no allowlist configured, production accepts beacons from ANY origin (warn-and-continue). (2) Client-controlled strings rating and navigationType are used raw as prom label values (metrics-rum.ts:159-163) -- only pathname is sanitized -- giving an unauthenticated label-cardinality/memory-growth vector bounded only by the 120/30s rate limit.
